newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish BBV, Argentaria awarded with Bolivian funds.
newsitem.headline: Spanish BBV, Argentaria awarded with Bolivian funds.

text.p: Spanish banks Banco Bilbao Vizcaya and Corporacion Bancaria Espanola (Argentaria) on Friday were awarded the only two private Bolivian licenses to manage private pension funds.
A joint statement from the two companies here in Madrid added to the overnight announcement in La Paz.
The two private funds will substitute one public fund and 39 funds managed by unions. This step completes the overhaul of the pension fund system in Bolivia.
The Bolivian government said it hopes enrollments will top one million people, out of 7.5 million of citizens, in between one- and five-years time.
According to the new Bolivian law, the new pension funds will pay around $250 dollars yearly to every person older than 65.
